steps.message: Turn off WiFi, then enable bluetooth

Execute: adb shell "svc wifi disable; cmd bluetooth_manager enable; echo '---WIFI---'; dumpsys wifi | grep -iE 'Wi[- ]?Fi is|mWifiEnabled|wifi is' | head -n 10; echo '---BT---'; dumpsys bluetooth_manager | grep -iE 'enabled|state' | head -n 30"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "svc wifi disable; cmd bluetooth_manager enable; echo '---WIFI---'; dumpsys wifi | grep -iE 'Wi[- ]?Fi is|mWifiEnabled|wifi is' | head -n 10; echo '---BT---'; dumpsys bluetooth_manager | grep -iE 'enabled|state' | head -n 30""
